target: Explain whether the rising B image-derived empty-area statistic reflects formation of internal RNA-poor domains, and identify a composition-dependent mechanism that could produce such domains.
known_relations: Reported B statistic rises from 0.01381 at 0 h to 0.08918 at 24 h; A falls from 0.01487 to 0.00446 (initial_measurements.json). This is an association with condition, not a causal effect of amplification.

C03 t=0 definition check: reported value equals arithmetic mean of per-object area ratios, not total dark area divided by total filled area. case_brief.md describes the latter; C03 did not check reserved late-time values.

Gel-purified length fractions differ at endpoint: M median field mean 0.000028, M+L 0.04446, M+S 0.09412 (fraction_dev.json). This is one preparation with no exact mixture, RNA yield, time course, or matched carryover control.

C01 gives 94.66% reference DNA reads; listed non-reference reads sum to 5.00%, and total listed reads are 99.66%. Read frequencies do not establish transcript abundance, RNA composition, or active valence.

C04 shows bulk dense/dilute partition ratios vary across tie-lines and species (reference K about 239-525 on nonzero tie-lines; variant K about 176-9032). Propagated marginal-error ranges are broad; tie-line 0 variant ratio is undefined. These are not cavity-local measurements or a B time series.
C02 gives time-only extrapolations: B exponential 36/48 h 0.12072/0.15632; B linear 0.12387/0.16352. No preparation-level prediction interval; these are descriptive and do not explain mechanism.

B1-S2_S3 (2021-02-08; abstract only) reports ternary PLP/RRP/RNA competition producing PLP-rich and RRP-RNA phases, with engulfment morphology depending on RNA:RRP stoichiometry and interaction hierarchy. This is protein-RNA organization, not evidence for RNA-RNA demixing.
B1-S2_S5 (2021-06-16; abstract only) reviews internal architectures in dynamic/reactive condensates but specifies no RNA-RNA mechanism, condition, or spatial composition signature.

B1-S2_S4 (2023-03-07; abstract only) reviews associative/segregative protein and nucleic-acid transitions without the needed RNA-RNA condition; B1-S2_S2 (2022-10-01; abstract only) discusses PAR versus RNA generally; B1-S2_S1 (2023-01-25; abstract only) reports crowder-driven phase-boundary crossing in a model protein condensate while internal molecular arrangement is relatively insensitive. None directly tests H1.

B1-S3 returned five abstracts from 385 matching records; only the five supplied abstracts were evaluated. B1-S3_S1 (2025-01-16) describes site-specific and chemically specific interactions as determinants of condensate composition, but gives no RNA-RNA or internal-domain result. B1-S3_S2 (2025-03-13) concerns protein-polyelectrolyte interactions and protein engineering. B1-S3_S3 (2025-03-31) broadly describes protein/nucleic-acid LLPS. B1-S3_S4 (2025-05-03) names multiphases among condensate-artificial-cell research frontiers. B1-S3_S5 (2025-03-25) concerns condensate mechanics and liquid-solid transitions. All are abstract-only; none supplies direct evidence for RNA-RNA demixing within one RNA-rich dense phase or a cavity mapping.

hypotheses.status: retained as a new, explicitly speculative transfer hypothesis; the final search returned no direct RNA-RNA internal-demixing evidence
hypotheses.statement: If reference-like and variant/length-class RNAs mix unfavorably in the dense phase, a composition fluctuation can cross a demixing instability; a locally RNA-poor internal domain could then appear as a cavity. Continued production or redistribution might increase its incidence, but the kinetic and image-mapping bridges are unestablished.
hypotheses.derived_consequence: Under the assumed dimensionless binary regular-solution free energy g(phi)=phi ln(phi)+(1-phi)ln(1-phi)+chi phi(1-phi), g''=1/phi+1/(1-phi)-2chi; local instability requires chi>1/[2phi(1-phi)], or chi>2 at phi=0.5. No supplied measurement estimates phi or chi.
hypotheses.evidence_update: The five supplied B1-S3 abstracts (search hit_count 385) concern condensate composition generally, protein-polyelectrolyte interactions, broad LLPS, multiphase research frontiers, and mechanics. They do not report direct RNA-RNA demixing within an RNA-rich dense phase, sequence/length-class internal domains, or RNA-poor cavities. Only the five supplied abstracts were assessed; the other hits were not evaluated.

gaps.description: Still no direct evidence that two RNA species or length classes demix within one relevant dense RNA phase, or that an internal composition domain is the segmented RNA-poor cavity. B1-S1 through B1-S3 supplied abstracts provide general condensate context or protein-RNA analogies, not the direct RNA-RNA relation or case-specific conditions.

The reported statistic is verified as the arithmetic mean of per-object ratios at t=0, while case_brief.md states a pooled-area ratio. Later timepoint mapping remains unchecked; population interpretations must respect this distinction.

variables_units.phi: local fraction of one of two modeled RNA species; dimensionless and unmeasured
variables_units.chi: dimensionless effective unlike-species interaction parameter under the assumed model; unmeasured
variables_units.g: dimensionless free energy per kBT under the stated model assumption
variables_units.f: reported image-derived empty-area fraction; dimensionless; t=0 object-mean mapping confirmed by C03, later mapping unchecked
variables_units.C_ref: bulk reference RNA concentration, ng/uL, available only for E04 endpoints
variables_units.C_var: bulk variant RNA concentration, ng/uL, available only for E04 endpoints

equations: g(phi)=phi ln(phi)+(1-phi)ln(1-phi)+chi phi(1-phi), 0<phi<1; assumed regular-solution model, not fitted.
g''(phi)=1/phi+1/(1-phi)-2chi; local spinodal condition g''<0, equivalently chi>1/[2phi(1-phi)].
No supplied equation maps local composition/domain geometry to f(t), and no dynamic equation is closed.

parameters_ranges.chi: No empirical range. Conditional instability threshold is 1/[2phi(1-phi)] for 0<phi<1.
parameters_ranges.phi: 0<phi<1 by definition; actual local and mean compositions unknown.

initial_boundary_conditions: No spatial initial condition, boundary condition, production/transport rates, or local composition data supplied. The spinodal criterion assumes a homogeneous binary mixture with a small perturbation; it makes no kinetic prediction.
observation_mapping: A local RNA-poor region would count as a cavity only if it produces a dark segmented region under the image protocol. C03 verifies the reported t=0 value is an arithmetic mean of object ratios; case_brief.md describes a pooled-area statistic, and late-time mapping is unchecked. E04 bulk concentrations are not local cavity concentrations or area/volume fractions.
alternatives: Population or measurement selection changes which droplets contribute to f without composition-demixing within individual droplets; tracking does not contain same-droplet cavity area/state histories.
Amplification-associated carryover or another reaction condition changes transcription or morphology; no matched-carryover control exists.
A single dense phase with non-equilibrium production/transport gradients produces dark regions without equilibrium RNA-RNA demixing; spatial production and transport are unmeasured.

Environmental or crowder-like changes can move a phase boundary without changing internal molecular arrangement, as a distinct model-protein abstract suggests; transfer to this RNA system is not established.
predictions: If H1 is correct, cavity interior and adjacent dense material should show a reproducible within-droplet reference:variant or length-class ratio contrast; changing RNA-class mixture at matched total RNA and reaction conditions should alter cavity occurrence or morphology. This is a future discriminating prediction, not an observed result.
Population/measurement selection does not require a within-droplet species-ratio contrast; f may change through inclusion or object weighting.
Bulk E04 tie-lines cannot distinguish H1 from the alternatives.
checks: The spinodal derivation is dimensionless and valid only under the assumed binary regular-solution model.
At phi=0.5 the threshold is chi>2; as phi approaches 0 or 1 it diverges for finite chi.
No fit, simulation, or estimate of chi or phi was run.
No RNA abundance is inferred from DNA-read frequencies; image area fraction is not treated as concentration, volume fraction, or free energy.

B1-S2 sources are abstracts only. S3 gives protein-RNA competition; S5 general internal architecture; S4 broad associative/segregative framing; S2 PAR/RNA review; S1 crowder effect in a protein model. None supplies an RNA-RNA internal-demixing condition or cavity mapping.
The t=0 f mapping is checked by C03; do not claim the same check for later times.
B1-S3 has 385 search hits, but only five abstracts were returned and assessed; no claim is made about the unreviewed hits.
B1-S3_S1 through B1-S3_S5 are abstract-only and none establishes direct RNA-RNA internal demixing or cavity identity.
The literature searches do not resolve local composition, the time-dependent mechanism, or the f aggregation conflict; no new model parameter is estimated.
evidence_conflicts: case_brief.md describes total dark area divided by total filled area; C03 shows that at t=0 the supplied values instead equal the arithmetic mean of individual object ratios. C03 checked only t=0, so late-time aggregation remains unverified.
Listed non-reference read fractions sum to 5.00%, not 4.66%; reference plus listed reads sum to 99.66%, leaving 0.34% unaccounted or due to rounding.
untested: Whether B transcripts contain DNA read variants in corresponding proportions.
Whether sequence/length classes have unfavorable mutual mixing under the actual transcription conditions.
Whether cavities are compositionally distinct phases or result from gradients, population selection, or image processing.
Whether local domains map to the reported f(t), particularly after t=0.
Whether the abstract-level RNA/protein condensate analogies apply to the present system.
Whether any direct RNA-RNA internal-demixing literature exists among unreviewed search hits; the five returned abstracts do not establish it.
dissent: Preserve the population/measurement alternative. Same-droplet cavity trajectories are unavailable, the statistic mismatch is resolved only at t=0, and three searches have not established the RNA-RNA or cavity bridge.

next_task.recognition: No specific recognition of the target study or the five returned sources beyond their supplied titles and abstracts.
next_task.summary: The final relation-oriented search B1-S3 returned five abstracts from 385 hits; only the five abstracts in the input were evaluated. B1-S3_S1 (2025-01-16) reviews site-specific and chemically specific recruitment in condensates; S2 (2025-03-13) reviews protein-polyelectrolyte interactions; S3 (2025-03-31) broadly discusses protein/nucleic-acid LLPS; S4 (2025-05-03) identifies multiphases as a research frontier; S5 (2025-03-25) reviews condensate mechanics. These are abstract-level background, not direct evidence for RNA-RNA demixing inside one RNA-rich dense phase. No direct sequence/length-class internal-domain or cavity relation was found in the supplied returns. H1 remains an explicitly new, speculative transfer hypothesis. The conditional spinodal result remains a consequence of an assumed regular-solution model, with phi and chi unmeasured. The case-specific bridge, local composition, kinetic explanation, and image mapping remain untested; the t=0 f mapping conflict is resolved only for t=0 according to C03.
candidates: Prioritize the unresolved observable and local-composition gap: establish the image statistic aggregation definition across time and obtain a within-droplet species-composition signature before adding mechanistic detail. Literature in the five final returned abstracts did not directly support RNA-RNA internal demixing.
